params.body:
## Why

On staging the vehicle-group switch on `/stocklist` (PR #289) did not read as one control: the
shell had rounded corners, but the filled blue segment was square, so the blue block stuck out of
the outline. The client acceptance test runs today, so the shape is fixed at its root instead of
patched on one corner.

## What was wrong

Three things, all in `resources/css/refresh.css`:

1. The shell carried `border-radius: 10px` while every segment had `border-radius: 0`. Any filled
   segment therefore showed square corners past the rounded outline.
2. The segmented shell was styled on `.ui-groups--segmented`, which is exactly as specific as the
   mobile rules on `.ui-groups` further down the file. Those later rules won, so on a phone the
   control got `gap: 6px` (two separate blocks instead of one control) and `overflow-x: auto`
   (a scroll row that would clip a segment's focus ring).
3. The divider between segments was a `border-left`, which counts towards the box width: the
   second and third segment were one pixel wider than the first.

## What changed

- The shell rule moved to `.ui-groups.ui-groups--segmented`, so its `gap`, `overflow`, `flex-wrap`
  and `padding` hold in every media query regardless of source order. No media rule targets the
  segmented control's own selector, so nothing else has to be repeated per breakpoint.
- The first and last segment carry the shell's radius minus its 1px border (9px); the middle one
  stays square. Per-corner radii, not `overflow: hidden`, precisely because clipping would cut off
  a segment's focus ring (the outline is 5px and there is no custom focus style).
- The divider is an `inset` box-shadow instead of a border, so it no longer takes layout width, and
  it is dropped on the active segment and on the one right after it.

The active state, the Livewire wiring (`wire:click="setGroup(...)"`) and the
`StocklistBrowser::SEGMENTED_MAX_GROUPS` threshold are untouched. CSS only, 20 lines.

## Screenshots

Rendered from the real component output (Livewire render with 2, 3 and 5 seeded groups) on the
built stylesheet, at 390 and 1280.

| | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 groups, 390 | blue block with square left corners, 6px gap between the two segments | one shell, blue rounded on the left, no gap |
| 2 groups, 1280 | blue sticks out of the rounded shell | blue follows the outline |
| 3 groups, 390 / 1280 | same square corner on the active segment | outline intact for first, middle and last active |

Also checked: the middle segment active (square, shell intact), the last segment active (rounded
right), and the select variant above the threshold (five groups), which is unchanged.

## Checked

- Segment widths are now exactly equal: 259 / 259 at 1280 with two groups (was 258.5 / 259.5), and
  172.66 / 172.67 / 172.66 with three.
- Icon and label are centred on one another in every segment (icon box 83.4-105.4, label box
  84.65-104.15 -> both centred on 94.4), so no baseline change was needed. On phones the icon is
  hidden by design below 640px.
- Focus ring is not clipped: the shell keeps `overflow: visible` at every width.
- `php artisan view:cache` plus `php -l` over all 416 compiled views: clean.
- `npm run build`: green (`public/build` untracked, not committed).
- `StocklistBrowser|SmokeTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|UiApiUsageTest|ClassReferencesResolveTest`:
  134 tests, 817 assertions, OK. Own MySQL database from `database/schema/mysql-schema.sql` plus
  the post-2026-07-28 migrations, dropped afterwards.
params.title: Stocklist: the group switch has one shape
